primarySourceHypothesis.title: Renaming a file is a multi-step process, only one of which is changing the name of the file
primarySourceHypothesis.finding: A renamed final path can exist while the rename operation still holds a DELETE handle. A std::ifstream reader without FILE_SHARE_DELETE can then fail. Using compatible native sharing permits immediate access.
primarySourceHypothesis.inference: Consistent with concurrent readiness test; the recorded failure lacks path/stage and native error, so it does not prove this is the observed cause.
